a: The user-defined ID of the DatasetConfig
Number of days of history that must be retained.
Number of days of activity data that must be retained. If not specified, retentionPeriodDays will be used. Set to 0 to turn off the activity data.
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
An optional user-provided description for the dataset configuration with a maximum length of 256 characters.
If set to true, the request includes all the newly created buckets in the dataset that meet the inclusion and exclusion rules.
A boolean terraform only flag to link/unlink dataset. Setting this field to true while creation will automatically link the created dataset as an additional functionality.
Organization resource ID that the source projects should belong to. Projects that do not belong to the provided organization are not considered when creating the dataset.
Defines the options for providing a source organization for the DatasetConfig.
The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
Type of identity to use for the DatasetConfig. Possible values: ["IDENTITY_TYPE_PER_CONFIG", "IDENTITY_TYPE_PER_PROJECT"]
The list of cloud storage bucket names to exclude in the DatasetConfig. Exactly one of the bucket_name and bucket_prefix_regex should be specified.

The list of regex patterns for bucket names matching the regex. Regex should follow the syntax specified in google/re2 on GitHub. Exactly one of the bucket_name and bucket_prefix_regex should be specified.
The list of cloud storage locations to exclude in the DatasetConfig.
The list of cloud storage bucket names to include in the DatasetConfig. Exactly one of the bucket_name and bucket_prefix_regex should be specified.

The list of regex patterns for bucket names matching the regex. Regex should follow the syntax specified in google/re2 on GitHub. Exactly one of the bucket_name and bucket_prefix_regex should be specified.
The list of cloud storage locations to include in the DatasetConfig.
The list of folder numbers to include in the DatasetConfig.
The list of project numbers to include in the DatasetConfig.
The location of the ReportConfig. The source and destination buckets specified in the ReportConfig must be in the same location.
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
The editable display name of the inventory report configuration. Has a limit of 256 characters. Can be empty.
If set, all the inventory report details associated with this report configuration are deleted.
The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
The delimiter used to separate the fields in the inventory report CSV file.
The boolean that indicates whether or not headers are included in the inventory report CSV file.
The character used to separate the records in the inventory report CSV file.
The frequency in which inventory reports are generated. Values are DAILY or WEEKLY. Possible values: ["DAILY", "WEEKLY"]
The day of the month to stop generating inventory reports.
The month to stop generating inventory reports.
The year to stop generating inventory reports
The day of the month to start generating inventory reports.
The month to start generating inventory reports.
The year to start generating inventory reports
The metadata fields included in an inventory report.
The destination bucket that stores the generated inventory reports.
